On the fakes it equals the original on 716 of 1127 named-pick docs and DIFFERS on 411 (the base resolver does not carry a name through a move). Not run on a real kernel. The pane on upstream has no brep-rs, so it would use path B: a shell/draft whose part was moved can pick the wrong face.

COMPOSITION LOSES GUARDS: in ['extrude-pocket','holes','shell-draft'] G-VOID (closed hollow) and G-CHAMFER no longer protect some chains. After a closed hollow, case hc2-then-join op1 (combine) and sd seed 353 pk1 (pocket) go refused -> built; hb2-box-c1-w2 and hb2-box-c3-w2 box1 go refused -> built. A move or turn of a closed hollow does not carry the 'closed hollow' mark (structural). Correctness of those built parts not measured. Do not wire the combined set into the pane until resolved.
G-FROM works only if the host passes ctx.fromUsage (draftFromUsage(script)); a ModelDoc does not record from:.
the group's translator has no execution budget; G-RIM only reached on excluded docs (needs a fillet).
